title: Eric Trump 支持的机器人startup因创始人借款购房缺钱未发薪
originalTitle: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
summary: Eric Trump 支持的机器人公司 Foundation Future Industries 因 CEO Sankaet Pathak 借用 460 万美元购房而陷入资金短缺，未能按时发放员工工资。
